title: NEST Pensions app
summary: UK pensions app built from inception: 100K+ downloads, 5K+ daily users, accessibility for older savers.
headline: NEST Pensions: a UK pensions app from the first commit
intro: A React Native app for savers in NEST, a UK workplace pension scheme: check balances, track contributions and manage accounts. I worked on it at TCS from its first commit to 100K+ downloads.
role: Mobile Application Developer at TCS: architecture, features, accessibility, testing and releases.

items.title: Accessibility for older savers
items.text: Proposed and built text zoom and voice-out. Both shipped.

items.title: Solid foundations
items.text: Typed Redux Toolkit store, RTK Query with caching and auth, and a reusable component library.

items.title: Secure by default
items.text: Keychain-secured tokens for financial data, push notifications and deep linking.
